title: Rory and the Velvet Mossy Glade
verses:
The sun drifted down in the deep velvet sky,
As Nia flew over the treetops so high.
She whispered to Rory that night was in sight,
And blanketed all of the woods in soft light.

Then Psittaco chirped from a soft mossy nest,
"It's time for our crew to slow down and to rest."
And Ricky trotted up with a cozy low hum,
To sit beside Rory until sleep would come.

Tilly found ferns that were scented and sweet,
And curled up her toes for a sleepy retreat.
While Benny leaned back like a mountain so still,
And rested his chin on the side of the hill.

Nia swooped down on a gentle night breeze,
To rest on a branch in the slumbering trees.
And Rory looked round at the warm, quiet space,
And felt so much love in their sweet hiding place.

A blanket of starlight shone over the glade,
Where shadows were soft and the cool breezes played.
Then Rory sang softly a slow lullaby,
Beneath the blue glow of the sleepy night sky.

Now Psittaco slumbers in Nia's warm wing,
While Ricky and Tilly dream sweeter than spring.
And Rory shuts eyes as the silver moon beams,
To join all his friends in a land of soft dreams.
